meaning_of_zero: No author EMC/NR4A3/native EMC identity in these source-labeled breast records; not biological or universal cohort absence.
patient_denominator_reason: Per-GSM library and source sample aliases are not a complete patient/case crosswalk; explicit 36 same-tissue links prevent counting 142 independent patients.

alias_disambiguation.MC: Mucinous Carcinoma, explicitly spelled out by source; not myxoid chondrosarcoma.
alias_disambiguation.MCB: Metaplastic Carcinoma of Breast; not native EMC.
alias_disambiguation.GSE9303: Distinct accession; no identity or measurements transferred.
